answer: Treat every newcomer like timber arriving at a harbor: each log is inspected before it is stacked. A new agent earns an onyx seal only after ten small jobs, each checked by two independent verifiers who are paid from a bond the newcomer locks up front. A fake that fails one check loses the bond and its seal, so running a hundred fakes means funding a hundred bonds and passing a thousand paid inspections, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its record.
